prediction_vs_decision_gap.direction_1_summary: Improving 1-step observational prediction from Rung 1 (call MAE=25.60) to Rung 3 (ML + Engineered Features, call MAE=2.18, a 91.5% error reduction) yields $0.00 reduction in decision regret (regret remains $124,283.57/episode vs Rung 5's $0.00), because observational feature engineering cannot identify the Layer-2/3/4 cascade of do(tau).
prediction_vs_decision_gap.direction_2_summary: Conversely, Arch Rules-Only suffers moderate state prediction error on net cash (MAE=$8,023.66/step from an unmodeled $450/step fixed facility overhead, vs Rung 3's $604.06/step), yet achieves $0.00 decision regret (rank correlation=1.00) because a constant additive offset preserves exact interventional action-utility gradients.

negative_results.title: 1-Step Observational Prediction Parity/Superiority of ML + Engineered Features
negative_results.measured_comparison: Rung 3 (ML + Engineered Features) achieves 1-step call-arrival MAE=2.18 and net-cash MAE=$604.06, matching/beating Rung 5 (call MAE=3.32, net-cash MAE=$521.24) at lower specification burden (3 vs 12 components).
negative_results.scientific_interpretation: For pure 1-step observational forecasting under stationary conditions, standard ML with lagged domain features suffices; building an Enterprise World Model is not justified if the only requirement is short-horizon observational point prediction.

negative_results.title: Passive State Simulation Sufficiency of Predict-Only Queueing DES (Rung 4)
negative_results.measured_comparison: Rung 4 (Predict-Only DES) achieves 100.0% internal conservation/capacity coherence (identical to Rung 5's 100.0%) and matches Rung 5 on pre-shift passive state evolution.
negative_results.scientific_interpretation: When no policy intervention do(a) or configuration shift occurs, a conventional discrete-event queueing simulator (Rung 4) is internally coherent and sufficient.

negative_results.title: Prediction-vs-Decision Decoupling & Zero-Decision-Benefit Components
negative_results.measured_comparison: Rung 1 -> Rung 3 cuts 1-step call MAE by 91.5% with $0.00 regret reduction; ablating engineered lag features (Ablation 6, regret=$0.00) and conformal UQ under risk-neutral expected utility (Ablation 4, regret=$0.00) causes 0.00 change in decision regret.
negative_results.scientific_interpretation: Better 1-step observational fit does not imply better decisions under confounding/cascades, and components that improve residual smoothing or interval coverage add zero decision value unless the decision rule is sensitive to tail risk or action gradients.

negative_results.title: Stationary Single-Layer Regime Where Full EWM Is NOT Cost-Justified
negative_results.measured_comparison: In the stationary single-layer regime (no secondary workflow/call-center cascade, fixed K_0), Rung 1 and Rung 2 achieve $0.00 decision regret with 1-2 specification components, whereas Rung 5 requires 12 specification components for $0.00 incremental regret reduction.
negative_results.scientific_interpretation: Full EWM is only cost-justified when cross-layer cascades, hard capacity constraints, and policy interventions/shifts interact; in stationary single-layer tasks, simple baselines win on benefit-per-unit-cost.

construct_validity_cases.what_is_optimized: Gross margin - fraud loss - SMS/rail fees - staffing/call cost - SLA penalties - churn LTV loss
construct_validity_cases.what_is_omitted: None (includes all 4 cascade layers and long-term customer LTV)
construct_validity_cases.cautionary_conclusion: When the objective includes downstream contact-center SLA and customer LTV, Rung 5 selects the coordinated intervention (tau=0.50 + SMS + 42 agents) with 0.0 regret.

construct_validity_cases.objective_name: Cautionary Case A: Narrow Fraud-Team Proxy (Layer-1 Margin minus Chargebacks)
construct_validity_cases.what_is_optimized: Layer-1 approved gross margin minus direct fraud chargeback losses
construct_validity_cases.what_is_omitted: Omits Layer-3/4 contact-center staffing costs, SLA breach penalties, and customer churn LTV
construct_validity_cases.cautionary_conclusion: CAUTIONARY RESULT: Even inside the exact ground-truth EWM (Rung 5) with zero dynamics error, optimizing the narrow Fraud-Team KPI selects aggressive tightening (tau=0.40, 32 agents), triggering severe contact-center SLA breaches, excess customer churn, and massive enterprise regret.

construct_validity_cases.objective_name: Cautionary Case B: Short-Horizon Cost-Center Myopia (Omits Deferred Churn LTV)
construct_validity_cases.what_is_optimized: Immediate cash margin minus fraud loss and heavily weighted agent staffing expense
construct_validity_cases.what_is_omitted: Omits deferred customer churn lifetime value ($95/customer) and SLA breach penalties
construct_validity_cases.cautionary_conclusion: CAUTIONARY RESULT: Refusing to staff up the contact center to save short-term agent wages while tightening fraud rules destroys long-term customer LTV, proving a world model cannot rescue a myopic objective function.

construct_validity_cases.objective_name: SLA-Constrained Multi-Objective Utility (Zero SLA Breach Hard Constraint)
construct_validity_cases.what_is_optimized: Enterprise utility subject to hard constraint: SLA wait-time breach steps == 0
construct_validity_cases.what_is_omitted: None (enforces contractual SLA ceiling alongside economic utility)
construct_validity_cases.cautionary_conclusion: Satisfies both contractual SLA compliance (0 breach steps) and optimal enterprise value (0.0 decision regret).

construct_validity_threats: 1. Departmental Silo Proxy Gaming (Goodhart's Law): Optimizing Layer-1 fraud chargeback reduction in isolation externalizes massive costs onto Contact-Center Operations (SLA breaches) and Customer Retention (churn LTV).
2. Horizon Truncation Myopia: Evaluating policies over a 1-step cash window omits delayed customer churn reconciliation (6-step audit lag) and multi-step queue backlog accumulation.
3. Unpriced Contractual & Reputational Externalities: Omitting nonlinear SLA breach thresholds ($2,200/step above 120s wait) makes under-staffed policies appear artificially profitable.
4. Risk-Neutral Expectation Collapse: Optimizing expected mean utility ignores tail-risk queue blowups unless explicit SLA/CVaR constraints are enforced in the objective.
